Tantita Security Services Nigeria Limited has donated two patrol vehicles to the Enerhen Police Division in Delta State to strengthen security operations within the area.
The vehicles – a Toyota Hilux and a Toyota Sienna SUV – were formally handed over to the police division on Monday.
The Tantita officials present at the handover ceremony were Brigadier General Efe Felix Edafioghor (retd.), General Manager, Security/Military Liaison, and Princess Daisy Jaja, the Administrative Manager, among others.
The Divisional Police Officer (DPO), Enerhen Division, CSP Nnamdi Okeke, expressed appreciation to TSSNL for the gesture, describing it as “a significant contribution towards improving security delivery and protecting lives and property”.
Okeke acknowledged Tantita for its commitment to supporting security operations.
”The vehicles will go a long way in strengthening patrol operations and improving the division’s capacity to respond promptly to distress calls within Enerhen and neighbouring communities”, the DPO said.
He added that the donation underscores the importance of strategic partnerships between security agencies and private security organisations in addressing security challenges and strengthening community safety.
